name: 竞品（分析/拆解/洞察）方法

map.按五个维度为我方与竞品打分并加权汇总：输出加权总分、逐维度差距、优势/劣势排序与: Score your own product and a competitor across five dimensions, then compute a weighted total: outputs the weighted score, per-dimension gaps, strengths/weaknesses ranking, and prioritized improvement suggestions.
map.= Σ(各维度得分 × 该维度权重)，权重之和恒为 1。维度：价格竞争力 / 功: = Σ(dimension score × dimension weight), where weights always sum to 1. Dimensions: Price Competitiveness / Feature Completeness / User Experience / Brand Trust / Service Support.
map.= 维度差距 × 权重，五项贡献之和 = 总分差。: = Dimension gap × weight; the sum of the five contributions = the total score difference.
map.：总分差 ÷ 竞品总分 ≥ +8% → 领先；−8% ~ +8% → 胶着；≤: : Total score diff ÷ competitor total ≥ +8% → Leading; −8% to +8% → Neck-and-neck; ≤ −8% → Behind. The gap threshold is expressed on a 10-point scale and is a commonly used empirical bracket in management reporting; it can be adjusted by industry.
map.：取「贡献为负且权重最高」的维度排序 —— 高权重上的劣势对总分的拖累最大，应优: : Rank dimensions by "negative contribution with the highest weight" — disadvantages on high-weight dimensions drag the total most and should be resourced first.
map.📚 深度解析：竞品对标加权评分（五维 / 权重敏感性）: 📚 Deep Dive: Competitor Benchmark Weighted Scoring (Five Dimensions / Weight Sensitivity)
map.立项前对标：判断与头部竞品的总分差落在哪个区间: Pre-project benchmarking: determine which bracket the total-score gap with leading competitors falls into.
map.差异化定位：找出高权重上的劣势维度，作为下一版功能的优先级依据: Differentiation: find the disadvantage dimensions on high weights to prioritize the next feature iteration.
map.评审会辩论：切换权重方案，验证结论是否只是权重假设的产物: Review debates: switch weight schemes to verify whether the conclusion is merely an artifact of the weight assumption.
map.五个维度为价格竞争力、功能完整度、使用体验、品牌信任、服务支持。各维度得分先按所: The five dimensions are Price Competitiveness, Feature Completeness, User Experience, Brand Trust, and Service Support. Each dimension score is first normalized to 0–100 by the chosen range (score ÷ range × 100), then weighted and summed to get each side's total; total score diff = Ours − Competitor.
map.= 总分差 ÷ 竞品总分 × 100。|百分比| < 8% 判为「双方胶着」，≥: = total score diff ÷ competitor total × 100. |percentage| < 8% → "neck-and-neck"; ≥ 8% → Ours leading or behind. Per-dimension contribution = (Ours − Competitor) × dimension weight; positive contributions go to "advantage dimensions", negative to "prioritized improvement".
map.量程 10、均衡权重（20/25/25/15/15%），五维我方 8/6/7/5: Range 10, balanced weights (20/25/25/15/15%), five dimensions Ours 8/6/7/5/9, Competitor 7/7/5/6/8 → Ours 69.5, Competitor 65.0, total diff +4.5 (6.9%), judged "neck-and-neck"; advantage dimensions are User Experience (+5.0) and Price Competitiveness (+2.0); prioritized improvement are Feature Completeness (−2.5) and Brand Trust (−1.5).
map.为什么切换权重后结论会翻转？: Why does the conclusion flip after switching weights?
map.总分差是「各维度差距 × 权重」之和，权重本身就是价值主张的声明。同一组打分在「: The total score diff is the sum of "dimension gap × weight"; the weights themselves are a statement of value proposition. The same scores may yield opposite conclusions under "price-biased" vs "experience-biased" — a flip actually signals a decision-sensitive dimension, so align the weight basis before declaring winners.
map.打分越界或量程填错会怎样？: What if scores go out of range or the range is filled in wrong?
map.低于 0 按 0 计、高于所选量程按量程上限计；量程本身若填 0 或非法值会回退: Below 0 counts as 0, above the chosen range counts as the range max; if the range itself is 0 or invalid it falls back to the default 10-point scale to avoid divide-by-zero or all-full scores.
map.五个维度的分数怎么定？: How are the five dimension scores determined?
map.页面附有评分口径参考表：价格竞争力看同规格性价比与折扣折算、功能完整度看核心功能: The page includes a scoring-criteria reference table: Price Competitiveness looks at same-spec value and discount conversion, Feature Completeness at core feature coverage and depth, User Experience at onboarding cost and error recovery, Brand Trust at reputation cases and credentials, Service Support at response speed and SLA. Align the criteria before scoring to reduce subjective drift.
map.加权总分、差距与贡献均按输入得分与权重线性换算，结果确定可复现（不含任何随机成分: Weighted total, gaps, and contributions are all linearly derived from input scores and weights; results are deterministic and reproducible (no random component).
map.±8% 的分档阈值是管理汇报经验值，不同行业可自行调整；结论对权重极敏感，务必先: The ±8% bracket threshold is an empirical management-reporting value and can be adjusted by industry; conclusions are highly weight-sensitive, so always align the weight basis first.
map.各维度得分为主观评分，建议先定义评分口径（见「维度评分口径参考」）再打分，减少个: Dimension scores are subjective ratings; define the scoring criteria first (see "Dimension Scoring Criteria Reference") before scoring to reduce personal bias.
map.本工具只做加权数学计算，不提供任何市场或投资结论；正式决策请结合真实调研数据: This tool only performs weighted math; it provides no market or investment conclusions. For formal decisions, combine it with real research data.
map.竞品对标加权评分：为「价格竞争力 / 功能完整度 / 使用体验 / 品牌信任 /: Competitor benchmark weighted scoring: score Ours and the competitor on five dimensions — Price Competitiveness / Feature Completeness / User Experience / Brand Trust / Service Support — then weight-sum by the chosen scheme (Balanced / Price-biased / Experience-biased / Feature-biased) to output the total-score difference, per-dimension gaps and their contribution to the total, and a ranked list of advantage vs prioritized-improvement dimensions.
map.五维度 × 双方打分（10 分制 / 5 分制 / 百分制可切换），自动换算到统: Five dimensions × both sides' scores (switchable 10-point / 5-point / 100-point), auto-converted to a unified 0–100 basis.
map.四套权重方案（均衡 / 重价格 / 重体验 / 重功能），一键切换看结论是否翻转: Four weight schemes (Balanced / Price-biased / Experience-biased / Feature-biased), one-click switch to see if the conclusion flips.
map.总分差与百分比、±8% 阈值判定（领先 / 胶着 / 落后）: Total-score difference and percentage, with ±8% threshold judgment (Leading / Neck-and-neck / Behind).
map.逐维度差距表：标注优势（红/绿按差距符号）与「差距 × 权重」对总分的贡献: Per-dimension gap table: marks advantages (red/green by gap sign) and the "gap × weight" contribution to the total.
map.输出优势维度 TOP2 与优先补强维度；附五维度评分口径参考；纯前端本地计算: Outputs TOP2 advantage dimensions and prioritized-improvement dimensions; includes a five-dimension scoring-criteria reference; pure front-end local computation.
map.差异化定位：找出高权重上的劣势维度，作为下一版功能优先级依据: Differentiation: find the disadvantage dimensions on high weights as the basis for the next feature iteration's priorities.
map.评分口径对齐：用维度定义表统一团队打分标准，减少主观漂移: Scoring-criteria alignment: use the dimension-definition table to unify the team's scoring standard and reduce subjective drift.
